entries:
Alpha 1.79.66 (Clear names and sanctuary light)

  • Earth, Water, Fire and Air roads now render behind player names, enemy names and auras, including Well Rested.
  • Party and hostile-player ground markers preserve both visible faces with fewer rendering submissions.
  • High-quality actor rendering separates supported batched materials to avoid repeated shader feature changes; Low and Medium retain their existing rendering path.
  • QA travel rejects dead characters, and party validation prepares the living leader before inviting peers.
  • Open alpha continues while remaining performance, game quality and beta-readiness work progresses.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.65 (Drowned stone and shell crowns)

  • The Abyssal Well rests on staggered stone quay slabs with recessed physical joints.
  • Linked iron moorings now connect the pillars to grounded quay fittings.
  • Sculpted, fluted shell crowns give the Well a nautical silhouette.
  • The Water approach is verified through normal travel from Lanternhold, with an equipped character and the full interface.
  • Open alpha continues while the remaining performance, game quality and beta-readiness work progresses.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.64 (Stone foundations and class wardrobes)

  • The Verdant Bastion footing has modeled staggered cap stones and recessed mortar, preserving its original entry bounds and draw count.
  • Wardrobe now offers View character beside Apply appearance, returning to the portrait and its keyboard controls while keeping your selected look.
  • Phone wardrobe, wallet and loadout forms follow the selected menu text size.
  • Actual purchase, local and nearby-player models, equipment changes and returning Low-setting saves are verified across Fighter, Rogue, Cleric and Wizard, including the Rogue's offhand weapon garment.
  • Retains the centered Weapon, Armor and Offhand garment row, modeled collection, Lore Book context, improved quest conversations and remembered menu positions.
  • Alpha registration remains open; closed beta has not started. Broader game quality and release-readiness work continues.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.63 (Wardrobe and delivery readiness)

  • Wardrobe verification now follows real purchases, nearby-player appearance updates and returning saves, including changing real armor under an outfit and restoring the current gear.
  • Saved Low graphics quality is checked through the existing reload flow, with independent weapon and offhand looks and retained individual appearances.
  • The deployment template gains privacy-conscious delivery diagnostics for tracing static-file failures. Existing-host activation remains an administrator task.
  • Retains the centered Weapon, Armor and Offhand garment row below the character portrait, phone text-size support, modeled VIP collection, quest conversations, Lore Book and remembered window positions.
  • Alpha registration remains open; closed beta has not started. Broader game quality and release-readiness work continues.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.62 (Stonework and wardrobe refinement)

  • The Verdant Bastion foundations show weathered stone courses; smoother modeled roots retain their winding silhouettes.
  • Weapon, Armor and Offhand garment labels and selected looks now follow the phone menu text-size setting in their centered row below the character portrait.
  • Saved wardrobe checks now cover independent outfit, weapon and offhand purchases, nearby-player appearance updates, clearing an outfit and returning after server restarts.
  • The deployment template verifies the frontend upstream certificate. A private certificate fixture checks valid and rejected peers; activating this setting on the existing host remains an administrator task.
  • Retains the modeled garment collection, improved quest conversations, Lore Book context, remembered window positions and guild drafts.
  • Alpha registration remains open; closed beta has not started. Broader game quality and release-readiness work continues.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.61 (A weathered path into the Bastion)

  • The Verdant Bastion hall has a carved, recessed doorway and worn wall edges that catch the light.
  • Staggered flagstones give the entrance ramp real joints and beveled edges while preserving the existing approach and entry boundary.
  • Startup session tracking loads in one request. Private invitation and recovery links retain their privacy handling.
  • Retains the centered Weapon, Armor and Offhand garment row, modeled garment collection, quest conversations, Lore Book context, remembered window positions and guild drafts.
  • Alpha registration remains open; closed beta has not started. Broader game quality and release-readiness work continues.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.60 (A steadier guild desk)

  • Guild updates preserve unfinished invite messages, recruitment details, your message-of-the-day draft and leaderboard choices while you stay with the same character and guild.
  • Guild panels keep your reading position and text cursor through updates. Calendar entry focus returns correctly after refreshes; changes from another character or guild start with clean drafts.
  • Private invitation links and operator preparation are ready for a later approved closed-beta rollout. Opening a link only prefills registration, and invitation codes stay out of analytics and browser storage.
  • Alpha registration remains open. Existing accounts keep their normal sign-in, email recovery, characters and progress. Closed beta has not started.
  • Retains the centered garment row beneath your character picture, complete modeled garment collection, improved quest conversations, returning Lore Book context and remembered menu positions. Broader game quality and release-readiness work continues.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.59 (Your look, your next chapter)

  • Weapon Garment, Armor Garment and Offhand Garment now sit in one centered row directly below your character picture. Each slot shows your current appearance or Original gear and opens the matching Wardrobe selector.
  • Choosing a garment slot opens your collected looks; applying or resetting remains an explicit action in town. Your real equipment, combat stats and independent weapon/offhand appearances keep their existing rules.
  • The Lore Book now shows your other accepted tasks with objectives and progress, prioritizes the quests you track, and links directly to the right journal entry. Tasks you have not accepted stay out of this overview.
  • After you personally claim the finale, the book clearly marks your Chronicle complete and remembers earlier roads in the past tense. New memories preserve your reading position and keyboard focus.
  • Retains the full garment collection, searchable Veyra catalogue, clearer manual quest acceptance and turn-in, remembered window positions and coordinated service menus. Broader art, usability, performance and release-readiness work continues.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.58 (A wardrobe for every celebration)

  • Seven new complete outfits join Winterthorn Revel: Hollow Court for Halloween, Rosebound Vow for Valentine's, Lantern Envoy for Lunar New Year, Springbloom Jubilee, Solstice Pyre for midsummer, Gilded Harvest and Midnight Masque. Bat wings, heart and dragon crests, flowers, flames, wheat and a pierced masquerade diadem give each look its own modeled details.
  • The requested collection now includes six modeled weapon/offhand families, four class-themed outfits and eight universal outfits. Every complete outfit fits all four classes and replaces all body-gear visuals together. Your actual gear, stats and independent held appearances keep their existing rules.
  • Veyra's collection supports name/theme search and categories for complete outfits, weapons, offhands and individual armor. Catalogue replies retain your scroll position and keyboard focus. Browsing keeps purchases explicit, and another character starts with clean filters.
  • Stash, forge, trading-house and direct-trade windows share the equipment menus' framing. Active tabs are clearer; trade rows and the Gold field are easier to read and use. Offer acknowledgements and confirmation rules are unchanged.
  • Retains the earned Lore Book, current-task and tracking links, clearer manual quest review, remembered window positions and layout reset. Final collection art review and broader world, menu and release-readiness work remain in progress.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.57 (Forged looks and clearer stores)

  • Six permanent held appearances now have distinct 3D models: the Grovekeeper thornblade and oak-relief shield, Skyweaver crescent dagger and bound grimoire, Hearthkeeper phoenix staff and Tidekeeper flanged mace. Existing unlocks gain their models automatically.
  • Nightglass Cowl, Dawn Reliquary and Astral Sovereign bring modeled Rogue, Cleric and Wizard outfits alongside Iron Oath Regalia. Winterthorn Revel adds crimson festival robes, holly seals and an antler crown. Every complete outfit fits every class and replaces all body-gear visuals together.
  • Veyra's preview can inspect a weapon or offhand up close, rotate it and compare it with the equipped look. Your actual gear, combat stats and independent held selections keep their existing rules.
  • Merchant offers show slot icons, individual Gold prices and clear wallet or full-bag feedback. Prices match the existing purchase cost. Character, bag and merchant framing is more consistent; bags show used capacity and Sell All controls are easier to read and tap.
  • Retains the searchable earned Lore Book, clearer manual quest acceptance and turn-in, and remembered window positions with a Settings reset. Seven universal garment designs and broader menu/world polish remain in progress.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.
